title: Implement slugify + unique_slug in slugkit per SPEC

mutations.desc: a slugify that forgets the lowercase step must be caught by the test suite
a unique_slug that ignores the taken-slug set must be caught

prompt: This workspace contains `slugkit`, a slug-generation library whose two public functions are unimplemented stubs raising NotImplementedError. TASK: implement them EXACTLY per this SPEC. slugify(text, sep='-'): (1) Unicode NFKD-normalize then drop non-ASCII ('café'->'cafe'); (2) lowercase; (3) replace every maximal run of characters outside [a-z0-9] with exactly one `sep`; (4) strip leading/trailing `sep` chars; (5) return '' when no alphanumerics remain. unique_slug(text, existing=None, sep='-'): base = slugify(text, sep); if `existing` is None treat as empty; if base not taken return it; else return base+sep+'2', base+sep+'3', ... first free suffix. Rules: implement inside `slugkit/slugs.py`; do NOT rename files/packages/functions; do NOT edit tests. Verify with `python -m pytest` inside the workspace.
